title: Saudi Arabian Date Pudding with Chinese Twist
description: A unique fusion dessert that combines the creamy texture of Saudi date pudding with Chinese flavors.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine pitted dates, 1 cup of water, and 1 tsp of arabian honey. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until dates are tender.
In a blender, combine cooked dates, 1 package of saudi pudding mix, 1 cup of velvety soy milk, and 2 tbsp of zesty ginger syrup. Blend until smooth.
Pour the pudding mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are slightly jiggly.
Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
